description: Core groundwork for the Profile tab: runtime ar/en locale switching that works on Android, iOS and Desktop without restart (JetBrains LocalAppLocale expect/actual + key(language) at the App root, with the navigation back stack / per-entry ViewModelStores / SaveableStateHolder hoisted above the key so ViewModels and the selected Home tab survive), AppLocaleManager as single language source, notification settings persisted in DataStore AppPreferences, new HomeRoutes, the shared state-hoisted designsystem components the profile screens need, and ALL new EN/AR string keys. Implements items 1-7 of d:/AndroidApps/JANA/JANA/.agents/tasks/profile_plan.md (read that file for exact signatures and the full string table). FEAT-002 depends on this feature.
steps: Plan item 1: create core/designsystem/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/designsystem/AppLocale.kt with `expect object LocalAppLocale { val current: String @Composable get; @Composable infix fun provides(value: String?): ProvidedValue<*> }` and actuals AppLocale.android.kt (androidMain: Locale.setDefault, LocalConfiguration.current.setLocale, LocalContext.current.resources.updateConfiguration with @Suppress("DEPRECATION"), return LocalConfiguration provides configuration), AppLocale.jvm.kt (jvmMain: Locale.setDefault + private staticCompositionLocalOf), AppLocale.ios.kt (iosMain: NSUserDefaults.standardUserDefaults 'AppleLanguages' + private staticCompositionLocalOf, default NSLocale.preferredLanguages.first()), following https://kotlinlang.org/docs/multiplatform/compose-resource-environment.html.

Plan item 1: create AppLocaleManager.kt (commonMain designsystem): class AppLocaleManager(initial: AppLanguage = loadSavedLanguage()) { val language: StateFlow<AppLanguage>; fun setLanguage(language: AppLanguage) — no-op when unchanged, else saveLanguage(language) then update the flow }. If MutableStateFlow does not resolve, add api(libs.kotlinx.coroutines.core) to core/designsystem/build.gradle.kts commonMain (already cached).

Plan item 1: edit AppLanguage.kt: LocalAppLanguage becomes staticCompositionLocalOf { AppLanguage.ENGLISH } (plain value); delete ApplyAppLanguageLocale, expect applyLocale and expect saveLanguageAndRestart plus their actuals in androidMain/jvmMain/iosMain AppLanguagePlatform.kt. Android saveLanguage = SharedPreferences write only (remove AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales and Locale.setDefault; keep the AppCompatDelegate fallback in loadSavedLanguage). JVM saveLanguage = prefs.put + flush (remove the ProcessBuilder restart + exitProcess). iOS saveLanguage/loadSavedLanguage use NSUserDefaults key 'jana_selected_language'.

Plan item 2: in core/navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/navigation/AppNavHost.kt add @Stable class AppNavState(backStack: SnapshotStateList<NavKey>, internal viewModelStores: MutableMap<Any, ViewModelStore>, internal saveableStateHolder: SaveableStateHolder) and @Composable fun rememberAppNavState(startDestination: NavKey): AppNavState (owns the DisposableEffect that clears all stores on dispose). AppNavHost(providers, navState: AppNavState, navigator = koinInject()) uses navState.backStack, rememberSaveableStateHolderNavEntryDecorator(navState.saveableStateHolder) and rememberEntryViewModelStoreDecorator(navState.viewModelStores). In EntryViewModelStoreDecorator.kt the function takes the stores map param and drops its own clearing DisposableEffect (keep onPop removal). Update KDoc explaining why state is hoisted.

Plan item 3: rewrite shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/App.kt: inside KoinContext get AppLocaleManager via koinInject, collect language with collectAsState, navState = rememberAppNavState(SplashRoute), providers = koinInject<List<FeatureEntryProvider>>(); CompositionLocalProvider(LocalAppLanguage provides language, LocalAppLocale provides language.code, LocalIsDarkMode provides darkModeState, LocalLayoutDirection provides Rtl/Ltr) { key(language) { JanaTheme(darkTheme = darkModeState.value) { AppNavHost(providers, navState) } } } with a comment that resources 1.7.0 caches by the non-observable Locale.current. Register single { AppLocaleManager() } in the inline module of shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/di/KoinInit.kt.

Plan item 4: in core/datastore/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/datastore/AppPreferences.kt add data class StoredNotificationSettings(enabled, liveLessonReminders, examReminders, newMessages, feedback, subscriptionExpiry; all default true), six booleanPreferencesKey (notif_enabled, notif_live_reminders, notif_exam_reminders, notif_new_messages, notif_feedback, notif_subscription_expiry), val notificationSettings: Flow<StoredNotificationSettings>, suspend fun setNotificationSettings(settings) in a single edit. Add implementation(project(":core:datastore")) to feature/home/build.gradle.kts commonMain.dependencies.

Plan item 5: create in core/designsystem/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/designsystem/: JanaSettingsComponents.kt (JanaSettingsSection, JanaSettingsRow with Icons.AutoMirrored.Rounded.KeyboardArrowRight chevron and isDestructive, JanaSwitchRow using toggleable(role = Role.Switch) + Switch(onCheckedChange = null)), JanaSelectionSheet.kt (JanaSelectionOption<T> + generic JanaSelectionSheet on JanaBottomSheet with selectable/RadioButton rows), JanaConfirmDialog.kt (AlertDialog, isDestructive uses colorScheme.error, isConfirmLoading disables buttons/dismiss), JanaProgressComponents.kt (JanaProgressRing Canvas ring, JanaLabeledProgressBar with LinearProgressIndicator(progress = { p }), JanaStatCard), JanaTextField.kt (modelled on feature/auth/.../components/AuthTextField.kt, plus errorText/enabled/leadingIcon), JanaBackTopBar.kt (TopAppBar + AutoMirrored ArrowBack, same colors as CourseDetailScreen). All text via params, colors from MaterialTheme/Color.kt tokens.

Plan item 6: append every new key from the plan's string table (42 keys, e.g. common_percent, profile_edit_profile, profile_notif_*, profile_logout_title, profile_language_sheet_title) under a '<!-- Profile tab -->' comment to core/designsystem/src/commonMain/composeResources/values/strings.xml AND values-ar/strings.xml with the EN/AR values given in the plan. Escape apostrophes (\') if any.
Plan item 7: add @Serializable data object EditProfile, Syllabus, Progress to sealed interface HomeRoute in core/navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/navigation/Routes.kt.

Run the verification commands, set this FEAT's status to 'completed', record results and any signature deviations in 'findings', and commit locally on develop (specific files only, never .agents/): 'feat: runtime language switching and shared settings components'.
